mapper.insert: INSERT INTO school_student ( student_id, student_name, college_name, college_code, class_code, class_name, grade, major_name, gender, phone, counselor_name, source_course_codes, sync_time, last_exam_sync_time, last_schedule_sync_time, sync_source ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{collegeName}, #{collegeCode}, #{classCode}, #{className}, #{grade}, #{majorName}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{counselorName}, #{sourceCourseCodes}, #{syncTime}, #{lastExamSyncTime}, #{lastScheduleSyncTime}, #{syncSource} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE -- 有真实值时覆盖；仅当新值是纯数字（脏数据）时才保留旧值 student_name = CASE WHEN #{studentName} IS NOT NULL AND #{studentName} NOT REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN #{studentName} ELSE student_name END, college_name = COALESCE(#{collegeName}, college_name), college_code = COALESCE(#{collegeCode}, college_code), class_code = COALESCE(#{classCode}, class_code), class_name = CASE WHEN #{className} IS NOT NULL AND #{className} != '' THEN #{className} ELSE class_name END, grade = COALESCE(#{grade}, grade), major_name = COALESCE(#{majorName}, major_name), gender = COALESCE(#{gender}, gender), phone = COALESCE(#{phone}, phone), counselor_name = COALESCE(#{counselorName}, counselor_name), source_course_codes = COALESCE(#{sourceCourseCodes}, source_course_codes), sync_time = #{syncTime}, last_exam_sync_time = COALESCE(#{lastExamSyncTime}, last_exam_sync_time), last_schedule_sync_time = COALESCE(#{lastScheduleSyncTime}, last_schedule_sync_time), sync_source = #{syncSource}
mapper.select: SELECT last_exam_sync_time FROM school_student WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT last_schedule_sync_time FROM school_student WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
